description: This file contains unit tests for the WebSocketBasicStream class, focusing on frame parsing, reading, writing, and error handling in WebSocket communication, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: StrictStaticSocketDataProvider
classes.description: A subclass of StaticSocketDataProvider that enforces that all expected read/write data is actually read or written, used for testing socket data exchange.

classes.name: WebSocketBasicStreamSocketTest
classes.description: Test fixture for WebSocketBasicStream socket operations, including setup of mock sockets and stream creation.

classes.name: WebSocketBasicStreamSocketSingleReadTest
classes.description: Test fixture for single read scenarios in WebSocketBasicStream.

classes.name: WebSocketBasicStreamSocketChunkedReadTest
classes.description: Test fixture for chunked read scenarios in WebSocketBasicStream.

classes.name: WebSocketBasicStreamSocketWriteTest
classes.description: Test fixture for write operation tests in WebSocketBasicStream.

classes.name: WebSocketBasicStreamSwitchTest
classes.description: Test fixture for testing read buffer size switching logic in WebSocketBasicStream.

methods.name: CreateTransportSocket
methods.description: Creates a mock transport socket with specified read/write data for testing.

methods.name: SetHttpReadBuffer
methods.description: Sets the initial HTTP read buffer with provided data.

methods.name: CreateStream
methods.description: Creates a WebSocketBasicStream instance for testing with specified socket data.

methods.name: CreateRead
methods.description: Prepares a single mock read for testing.

methods.name: CreateChunkedRead
methods.description: Prepares a chunked read with specified data split into multiple chunks.

methods.name: PrepareWriteFrame
methods.description: Prepares a WebSocket frame for writing tests.

methods.name: MicrosecondsFromStart
methods.description: Returns a timestamp offset from a fixed start point for testing timing-based logic.
